system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Fortitude, Intermediate Protean (Shape of the Beast). Developed by a Gangrel for defense, this Discipline toughens the user's skin like a badger's thick hide, specifically resisting impaling attacks. Costs one Blood Trait to activate and lasts one scene. Piercing melee attacks (knives, stakes, spears, arrows) inflict one less level of lethal damage for the scene, to a minimum of none; slashing weapons are unaffected unless used to impale. While active, the user may spend a Stamina-related Physical Trait (one per test) for a retest on staking attempts, including the two additional tests required to stake successfully. It has no effect against bullets or other high-velocity projectiles, and other levels of Fortitude may still be applied normally.

Costs 6 Experience Traits to learn.
